Name: Ilucie's Shroomie - the adorable walking Mushroom
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
🍄 Meet Shroomie, the cutest little walking mushroom in the Valley! 🍄
It loves to wander around your farm and every now and then, a new Shroomie pops up and joins the fun.

Shroomie drops Cinder Shards and later on Magma Caps, just like its feral ancestors hiding somewhere in the depths of Ginger Island. 
But don’t worry: even though Shroomie looks like a red-capped toadstool, this little guy is completely harmless and not poisonous at all.

You can purchase Shroomie from Marnie once you own a coop.

Bring a bit of forest magic to your farm and let Shroomie join your animal family.

_________________________________________________

The mod includes i18n support (English & German).
